name: Theseia
summary: The hero-feast of Theseus on the day after the Pyanepsia — procession, games and a public meal — enlarged after Cimon brought the hero's bones home from Skyros.
testimonia: Pausanias 3.3.7 (Cimon recovers the bones of Theseus from Scyros)
Plutarch, Theseus 36.1–4 (the Theseion and the eighth-day honours)
